hook_en: Remember what God has already done. 🙏
reflect_en: Midweek, when it's easy to see only what's still undone, Asaph chose to remember the works of the LORD and ponder His mighty deeds. The God who was faithful before is the same God walking with you today.
q_en: What has God done for you that you never want to forget?
x_en: I will remember the works of the LORD; yes, I will remember Your wonders of old.
tiktok: Remember what He's already done 🙏 Psalm 77:11–12 — I will remember Your wonders of old
yt_title: I Will Remember the Works of the LORD | Psalm 77:11–12 #Shorts
li_open: Healthy teams remember their wins, not just their problems.
li_quote: I will remember the works of the LORD; yes, I will remember Your wonders of old.
li_body: Asaph steadied himself by remembering what God had already done. Leaders who pause to recall answered prayers, and celebrate them with their people, build communities whose faith for tomorrow rests on God's faithfulness yesterday.
hook_es: Recuerda lo que Dios ya ha hecho. 🙏
reflect_es: A mitad de semana, cuando es fácil ver solo lo que falta, Asaf decidió acordarse de las obras de Dios y hacer memoria de Sus maravillas antiguas. El Dios que fue fiel ayer es el mismo que camina contigo hoy.
q_es: ¿Qué ha hecho Dios por ti que nunca quieres olvidar?
x_es: Acordaréme de las obras de JAH: sí, haré yo memoria de tus maravillas antiguas.
key_en: I will remember the works of the LORD
key_es: haré yo memoria de tus maravillas antiguas
